interpretation.algebraic_residual: HV minus V Lambda measures solution of the discrete eigenproblem, not continuum discretization error
interpretation.normalized_operator_metric: each residual norm divided by the corresponding norm of the same-grid Dirichlet Hamiltonian
interpretation.raw_norm_warning: raw norms compare matrices on changing spaces and inherit the h^-2 kinetic scale

limitations: Raw matrix norms are dimension- and discretization-scale-dependent.
Normalized norms compare each residual only with its same-grid Hamiltonian.
Algebraic eigenpair residuals do not measure continuum error.
The result is not semiconductor evidence or scientific validation.
